facecam.notes: Top panel of the 1080x1920 output, 720 px high, which is 37.5 percent of 1920 and inside the 35 to 40 percent band. Upscale factor is 1080 divided by 480, which is 2.25 and inside the 2.5 limit.

gameplay.notes: Bottom panel of the 1080x1920 output, below the facecam. Source crop sits left of the facecam crop, so the two crops do not overlap in the source.

notes: Verify with an extracted frame on every build; streamers change overlays. Rects taken from the verified Speed scooter-bust example EDL.
